titulo.alumno: Explaining what a decision is based on

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it adds in context.

piezas.titulo: にもとづいて shows that an action or decision takes something as its basis or foundation.
texto: It can go with data, rules, agreements or criteria. Check whether the text states that the decision is based on evidence, or only that both elements coexist.
利用 者 の 調査 結果 に もとづいて、開館 時間 を 変更 しました。 (The opening hours were changed based on the results of the user survey.)
合意 した 基準 に もとづき、各 案 を 評価 します。 (We will evaluate each proposal according to the agreed criteria.)
